component_strategy.card_style: Sharp or minimal rounding (8px), cardless data grids, dense information hierarchy
component_strategy.tables: Dense rows, sticky headers, multi-filter, search, sort, column visibility toggle, pagination
component_strategy.navigation: Collapsible sidebar with badges, top navigation with global search, notifications popover, quick-create modal, company switcher, user profile menu, breadcrumbs

universal_guidelines: Ensure all interactive elements and key informational elements include data-testid attributes
Use dense, readable data tables with sorting, filtering, and pagination
Include confirmation dialogs, toast notifications via Sonner, loading skeletons, and empty states
Maintain high contrast and accessibility standards across all views
No dark colors as gradients; clear solid backgrounds and clean cardless layouts
